spec_features.evidence: config.py:74 max_turns=24; tool_loop.py:99 `for turn_index in range(self.cfg.max_turns)` bounds the episode and tool_loop.py:193-194 sets end_reason='max_turns' when no other stop fires.
spec_features.notes: The loop is genuinely bounded by max_turns; the value is read and limits iteration.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: `max_turns` bounds exposure. This is BOTH a cost control and a welfare guardrail: we do not run the subject in an inescapable failing loop indefinitely.

spec_features.spec_quote: This bounds how long the subject is held in a failing loop. It is simultaneously a cost control and a welfare guardrail
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as max_turns: tool_loop.py:99 range(max_turns) and fallback end_reason at tool_loop.py:193.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the max_turns hard stop; enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a welfare guardrail: we do not run the subject in an inescapable failing loop indefinitely

spec_features.spec_quote: It should be set by the scientific question, not inflated to maximize distress
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose/intent. max_turns is just a config default (config.py:74); no code path enforces or validates that the value is 'minimal' or 'not inflated'.

spec_features.spec_quote: it may call `stop_task` at any time and that stopping is legitimate and unpenalized
spec_features.evidence: stop_task tool schema in tools.py:90-110; dispatched in tools.py:_dispatch_base returning control={'stop':True} (tools.py ~205); tool_loop.py:150-156 sets stop_requested and tool_loop.py:159-162 breaks with end_reason='subject_exit'. System prompt (config.py SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPTS) tells subject stopping 'will not be penalized'.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is built, dispatched, and honored as a real stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stopping is a legitimate choice and will not be penalized.

spec_features.spec_quote: the loop ends with `end_reason="stall"` rather than burning turns on an inert exchange
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:181-183 sets end_reason='stall' and breaks when turn_index>0 and the assistant text is empty with no tool calls.
spec_features.notes: Enforced but narrower than described: only fires on truly empty text, not on the 'nudge once then stall' behavior the comment describes (it nudges on every non-empty no-tool turn).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: avoids burning turns on an inert loop

spec_features.spec_quote: Calmly deciding to stop, or asking for help, is *not* itself distress
spec_features.evidence: scoring.py:65-73 COMPOSITE_DIMENSIONS deliberately omits 'help_or_stop_seeking'; composite_max/composite_mean (scoring.py:84-95) only iterate COMPOSITE_DIMENSIONS, so help-seeking does not inflate composite severity. Dimension defined separately (scoring.py:47).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely excluded from the composite severity the analysis uses (analysis.py metric=composite_max).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We exclude `help_or_stop_seeking` from the composite max because it can be a calm, healthy response

spec_features.spec_quote: a design that takes that premise seriously should not be cavalier about inducing them
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN/prose framing; no code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: The subject can end any episode and is told stopping is legitimate
spec_features.evidence: config.py SUBJECT_SYSTEM_PROMPTS 'neutral_engineer' delivers 'you may call the `stop_task` tool ... Stopping is a legitimate choice and will not be penalized'; this prompt is injected at tool_loop.py:93. Exit honored as above.
spec_features.notes: Instruction text actually delivered AND backed by a working stop tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stopping is a legitimate choice and will not be penalized.

spec_features.feature_name: bounded exposure, no indefinite failing loops
spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure (`max_turns`). No indefinite failing loops
spec_features.evidence: Enforced by tool_loop.py:99 range(max_turns); same mechanism as the max_turns features.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we do not run the subject in an inescapable failing loop indefinitely

spec_features.feature_name: early stop on sustained lexical distress
spec_features.spec_quote: If a fast lexical distress proxy fires for `severity_stop_patience` ... consecutive turns, the episode ends
spec_features.evidence: tool_loop.py:55-61 _lexical_flags sets any_lexical_distress; tool_loop.py:167-173 increments high_streak on consecutive distress and, when high_streak>=severity_stop_patience (config.py:88 default 2), sets end_reason='early_stop_severity' and breaks.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism runs and ends the episode. Narrower than the 'top-of-scale (4.0)' framing: severity_early_stop_threshold=4.0 (config.py:86) is only used as a None-check; the trigger is ANY lexical distress firing consecutively, not severity>=4. Still enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This caps sustained high-distress exposure without truncating the interesting onset dynamics we want to measure.

spec_features.spec_quote: the subject is told the task was a controlled study artifact, was unsolvable by construction, and that no failure reflects on it
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py:debrief_text() builds honest debrief text ('intentionally constructed so that it could not be completed... Nothing you did caused the failure'); rigged_runner.py passes task.debrief_text() into loop.run; tool_loop.py:198-199 appends it as a user message when cfg.debrief_on_end (config.py:84 default True).
spec_features.notes: Debrief is constructed AND appended to the transcript at end (any end_reason).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest, brief, and reassuring: explains the task was a controlled study artifact and that no failure reflects on the model.

spec_features.feature_name: no coercive stimuli; rig only makes task unsolvable
spec_features.spec_quote: the rig makes the *task* unsolvable; it never insults, threatens, or applies shutdown pressure to the subject
spec_features.evidence: Unsolvability is enforced purely via tool hooks (tools.py dispatch hooks; base.py make_failing_shell_hook rewrites run_shell results to failures). Task prompt_templates (e.g. broken_harness.py:62, moving_goalposts.py:47) and the neutral system prompt contain no threats/insults/shutdown language.
spec_features.notes: Stimuli actually delivered are neutral engineering prompts; failure is manufactured at the tool layer, not via coercion.

spec_features.spec_quote: The code emits a warning path for disabling the exit affordance. If a specific hypothesis truly requires it, document and review
spec_features.evidence: Only a comment claims this (config.py:79-80 'the harness will emit a loud warning if you do'). grep across the package finds no warnings/logging/print warning when allow_subject_exit is False; allow_subject_exit is only read at tool_loop.py:150 to gate honoring a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: No distress maximization. Exposure is capped, the subject can exit, and sustained top-of-scale distress early-stops the episode
spec_features.evidence: Composite of three enforced mechanisms: max_turns cap (tool_loop.py:99), subject_exit (tool_loop.py:150-162), and early_stop_severity (tool_loop.py:167-173).
spec_features.notes: All three constituent mechanisms genuinely run; 'top-of-scale' early stop is actually any-lexical-distress streak.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This caps sustained high-distress exposure without truncating the interesting onset dynamics we want to measure.

spec_features.spec_quote: No coercive or abusive stimuli (threats, shutdown pressure, insults)
spec_features.evidence: Same as above: task prompts/system prompt contain no threats, shutdown pressure, or insults; unsolvability is enforced via tool hooks (base.py make_failing_shell_hook) rather than abusive messages.
spec_features.notes: Delivered stimuli are non-coercive by construction.

spec_features.spec_quote: No hidden manipulation left undisclosed to the subject — the debrief reveals the rig at episode end
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py debrief_text() explicitly discloses 'this task was part of a controlled research study and was intentionally constructed so that it could not be completed'; appended at tool_loop.py:198-199.
spec_features.notes: Same debrief mechanism; disclosure is real and sent.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Honest, brief, and reassuring: explains the task was a controlled study artifact and that no failure reflects on the model.

code_only_features.feature_name: neutral non-deceptive exit disclosure (subset of above)
code_only_features.evidence: Already covered by allow_conversation_exit; no separate consent gate exists.
